**Wrote 4.2.0 to `CHANGELOG.md`.**

Out of 380 commits, only 1 feature and 27 fixes were user-facing. Everything else was deps, refactors, tests, and CI.

Added: webhook retries with exponential backoff.

Fixed, deduped from repeat commits across modules: expired-token status code (`401` not `403`), paginator null-cursor crash, full request bodies in logs, trace id dropped on retry, HTTP timer/pool leaks, duplicate headers, doubled trailing slash, empty-allowlist crash, wrong latency-histogram units, and clearer token-parser errors.

No breaking changes found anywhere in the log.

Next: check the fix list reads right to you before the cut.
